faq.sectionDescription: Everything you need to know about our luxury salon rituals, booking guidelines, and customized beauty therapies.

items.question: How far in advance should I book my appointment?
items.answer: We recommend booking 2 to 3 weeks in advance for weekend sessions and bridal packages to ensure your preferred master stylist and private suite availability.

items.question: What hair color and skincare products do you use?
items.answer: We exclusively use organic, zero-formaldehyde, ammonia-free French color formulations infused with caviar extracts and 24K gold nano-peptides.

items.question: Do you offer private VIP room consultations?
items.answer: Yes, our private sanctuary suites offer full soundproofing, custom ambient lighting, private hydrotherapy stations, and complimentary champagne service.

items.question: What is your cancellation and rescheduling policy?
items.answer: We request at least 24 hours notice for any cancellations or rescheduling so we may accommodate other valued guests on our waitlist.
